excerpts.text: A tiny mouse ran across the sleeping paw of a giant lion. The lion woke up and caught the mouse in his big hand. The mouse begged for mercy, and the lion let him go with a smile.
Honeybees are flying insects that gather sweet nectar from blooming flowers. They use this nectar to make honey inside their busy hives. A single hive can hold thousands of buzzing bees.
